question: Which Chinese city hosted the 2025 Asian Winter Games from 7 to 14 February?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harbin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **9th Asian Winter Games** are scheduled to be hosted by **Harbin**, the capital city of **Heilongjiang Province** in **China**.
 
• The multi-sport event is set to take place from **7 February to 14 February 2025**, featuring athletes from across the **Asian continent**.
 
• This is the **second time** that **Harbin** has been selected as the host city; it previously hosted the **3rd Asian Winter Games** in **1996**.
 
• The **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)** officially awarded the hosting rights to **Harbin** during its **42nd General Assembly** held in **Bangkok** in **2023**.
 
• The official slogan for the **2025** games is "**Dream of Winter, Love among Asia**," which aims to promote unity and the spirit of winter sports.
 
• The official mascots for the games are two **Siberian tiger** cubs named **Binbin** and **Nini**, while the emblem is named "**Breakthrough**," depicting a short-track speed skater and a lilac flower.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Winter Games (AWG):**
 
 
• The **Asian Winter Games** is an international multi-sport event held every **four years** for members of the **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)**.
 
• The **first-ever** edition of the games was held in **1986** in **Sapporo**, **Japan**, following a proposal by the **Japanese Olympic Committee** in **1982**.
 
• The games serve as a platform for **Asian** athletes to compete in winter disciplines such as **alpine skiing**, **biathlon**, **curling**, **figure skating**, **ice hockey**, and **speed skating**.
 
 
 
• **Host Country History:**
 
 
• **China** has a significant history with the **Asian Winter Games**, having hosted the event previously in **1996 (Harbin)** and **2007 (Changchun)**.
 
• The hosting of the **2025** games follows China's successful organization of the **2022 Winter Olympics** in **Beijing**, which boosted the popularity of winter sports in the **country**.
 
 
 
• **Harbin - The Ice City:**
 
 
• Known as the "**Ice City**," **Harbin** is world-renowned for its cold climate and the annual **Harbin International Ice and Snow Sculpture Festival**, which is one of the largest of its kind globally.
 
• Located in **Northeast China**, the city provides ideal natural conditions and existing high-quality infrastructure for hosting major **winter sports** competitions.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA):**
 
 
• The **OCA** is the governing body of sports in **Asia**, currently consisting of **45 National Olympic Committees**.
 
• It is responsible for organizing the **Asian Games**, **Asian Winter Games**, **Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games**, and **Asian Youth Games**.
